 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth?access_type=offline&client_id=0000000000-example.apps.googleusercontent.com&code
 _challenge=EXAMPLE&code_challenge_method=S256&prompt=consent&redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fexample.invalid%2Foauth&response_
 type=code&scope=openid&state=EXAMPLE
 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
